sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Forest Man is a simple yet addictive game that challenges you to chop wood while avoiding branches. The gameplay is fast-paced and action-packed, with you using your mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to navigate the forest floor and avoid obstacles. The game features two variable environments, each with its own set of challenges and hazards. With ten unlockable characters, each with its own strengths and weaknesses, the game demands strategy and skill. Whether you're playing as the default character, a lumberjack with average stats, or one of the unlockable characters, each with its own unique abilities, the gameplay remains the same – you'll need to chop wood, avoid branches, and survive as long as possible.

The game also features a scoring system, where you earn points for each piece of wood you chop. The score increases in value as you progress through the game, with each level featuring increasingly difficult obstacles and challenges. The game also features a daily high score system, where you can compete with other players to see who can achieve the highest score. With its simple yet addictive gameplay, Forest Man is a game that's easy to pick up but hard to put down.

One of the standout features of Forest Man is its one-click control system. With the game using a single mouse click or keyboard button to control the character's movement, the game is incredibly easy to pick up and play. The one-click system also makes the game perfect for playing on-the-go, with the game's simple controls allowing you to play for short periods of time without getting frustrated. However, the one-click system also makes the game more challenging, as you'll need to rely on your reflexes and timing to avoid obstacles and earn points.
